description: Creates a NEW database, billed like any other, holding the data as it was at a given minute of the source's restore window (list_database_backups; Valkey: the last snapshot before that minute), with the same users and passwords. The source is not touched and may have been deleted in the last 7 days. Retrying the same call is safe. Scope: vms.create.

at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, UTC unless an offset is given, e.g. 2026-10-14T09:30:00Z.

size_gb.description: Memory in GB, one of the sizes of get_database_options for the region. Default: 1, or the source's size.

name: restore_database
title: Restore into a new database
